purpose: Use the same fresh10 cases to identify whether one observable state at the first V7/V19 action divergence separates V19 wins from V19 losses.
observe: first V7 versus V19 self-action difference
added market SELL orders by product and quantity
market prices and inventory at that step
self and opponent cash at that step
self shed inventory at that step
terminal self difference V19 minus V7
decision_rule: If one directly observed feature cleanly separates positive from negative terminal delta across all ten cases, retain it as the next gate candidate. Otherwise close this line without tuning.
restrictions: Do not modify V7 or V19.
Do not add thresholds after seeing results.
Do not inspect later divergences unless first divergence is identical or absent.
Do not create a new policy in this diagnostic.
